reader_summary.overview: James Aitken is the Founder of Aitken Advisors, a one-man macroeconomic consultancy based in Wimbledon. James has been a repeat guest on the show. Our very first conversation five years ago including his background and process, and the most recent one last year are replayed in the feed.

key_points.text: James Aitken is the Founder of Aitken Advisors, a one-man macroeconomic consultancy based in Wimbledon.
If you search on the podcast page at capitalallocators.com , you can find the rest of his appearances.
Our conversation this time around covers the precarious set-up from fiscal and monetary policy.
